entries.land_location_as_stated: on an old blue stone quarry with a lovely, secluded pond
entries.description: Lesbian separatist homestead on 45 acres on an old quarry with a pond; grows most of its own food, keeps goats, chickens and ducks, holds summer herbal and psychic healing intensives, working on wheelchair accessibility. Welcomes lesbians of all ages as visitors for up to five days.
entries.raw_text: ROWDYBUSH FARM (Susun Weed & Clove), 3136 Fishcreek Rd, Saugerties, NY 12477. Our dream is to be part of a network of SAFE SPACES for wimmin. Right now we are a hard working lesbian separatist homestead on an old blue stone quarry with a lovely, secluded pond. We provide almost all our own food with three large gardens,a solar greenhouse, dairy goats, chickens, ducks and fruit trees (to be planted this spring). We support the land partly by working outside jobs and partly by holding Herbal and Psychic Healing Intensives every summer. We are working on wheelchair accessibility for house and campsites. We welcome lesbians of all ages as visitors for up to five days, $2-5/day donation. We have/are: 3 lesbians, 45 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, wimmin living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: 3 lesbians living on the land, described as a homestead, so Intentional Community/Cooperative (three or more). Contact name taken from parentheses. Land: street address is the land, copied to land_*. Residents: 3 lesbians with 'wimmin living and working on the land'. Focuses: 'lesbian separatist homestead'; 'provide almost all our own food'; 'Herbal and Psychic Healing Intensives' (workshops); 'working on wheelchair accessibility' (disabled women); Psychic Healing suggests spirituality/ritual. Accepted: lesbians only.

entries.description: Womyn's land in its 6th year on 150 acres between Ithaca and Watkins Glen; 6-10 lesbians living there, moving to more focused land use, investing in farm equipment; healing is a focus; welcomes girl children, and visitors and new members tentatively.
entries.raw_text: NORTHWOODS RD 1 Box 156, Alpine, NY 14805 (607)594-3536. (Between Ithaca & Watkins Glen, NY.) Northwoods is in its 6th year as womyn's land, now moving this spring to a more focused use of the land than just gardening and living. We're investing in farm equipment and need work energy. Healing is a focus of many of us. We need everyone here to be self sufficient and self motivated. We welcome: visitors (maybe), new members (perhaps, cautiously), girl children. We have/are: 6-10 lesbians, 150 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: 6-10 lesbians living on land, so Intentional Community/Cooperative. Land: rural route is the land. Residents: range 6-10, smaller stored. Accepted: girl children named; lesbians as residents/visitors. Focus: farm equipment and 'self sufficient' as farming/self-sufficiency. 'Healing is a focus' not coded as spirituality.

entries.land_location_as_stated: in a hollow on a creek in the mountains of WV
entries.description: Two lesbians building a womyn's homestead on 25 secluded acres in a WV mountain hollow; carpenters, woodworker/blacksmith and farmers who will teach skills to serious apprentices. Visitors welcome and expected to help. Welcomes girl children and apprentices.
entries.raw_text: MISTY BOTTOMS FARM c/o Mimi & Judy, Rt 86 Box 15A, Jumping Branch, WV 25969. We are building a womyn's homestead on 25 acres in a hollow on a creek in the mountains of WV. Secluded land, access by foot or 4-wheel drive. We are carpenters and woodworker/blacksmith as well as farmers. Will teach skills to serious apprentices. Visitors welcome and expected to help (bring own food). We welcome: girl children and apprentices. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 25 acres, housing/permanent structure, electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: two-woman rule, 2 lesbians; no recruiting of members (apprentices only), so Private/Individual Land. Land: rural route copied. Residents: 2 lesbians with 'women living and working on the land'. Focus: 'Will teach skills to serious apprentices' (workshops/education); 'building a womyn's homestead' and 'farmers' (farming/self-sufficiency). Accepted: girl children named; lesbians as residents.

entries.description: Collective of seven wimmin caring for 40 acres, striving toward self sufficiency, with a communal kitchen. Not separatists; spiritual, artistic, scientific and political. Welcomes girl and boy children, non-lesbian women, and leashed dogs; visits require work exchange or cash.
entries.raw_text: SILVER CIRCLE FARM c/o Gwen O Demeter, Box 100 Rt 5, Holly Springs, MS 38635. We are a collective of seven wimmin dedicated to caring for 40 acres and each other. We strive to tolerate our differences as well as enjoy them. We are striving toward self sufficiency. Visits require work exchange and/or cash for short stays. Longer visits/meals negotiable. Have communal kitchen. We are not separatists. We are spiritual, artistic, scientific, political, but most important we are loving wimmin trying to give each other space to grow! We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs (but only on leash). We have/are: 7 lesbians, 40 acres, permanent structures (in process), outdoor plumbing, electricity (also hook-ups for couple of RV's), camping space, woods, farm land, wimmin living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: collective of seven living on land, so Intentional Community/Cooperative. Land: 'Box 100 Rt 5' treated as rural route. Residents: 7 lesbians with 'wimmin living and working on the land'. Accepted: girl and boy children and nonlesbian women named. Focus: 'striving toward self sufficiency'; 'spiritual' (spirituality/ritual). Rejects separatism ('We are not separatists'), so not coded.

entries.description: Family of 6 lesbians, 4 living on 18 acres 35 miles SE of Austin, developing a self sufficient space with animals, garden, orchard and stain-glass and spinning workshop. Welcomes girl children and dogs maybe leashed; no drugs, alcohol or cigarettes.
entries.raw_text: EARTH CURRENT FARM Rt 1 Box 137L, Red Rock, TX 78662 (512)764-2706. We are a family of 6 lesbians, 4 on the land. We are developing a self sufficient space 35 miles SE of Austin, that will provide most of our food and bring in at least part of our survival money. Our plans include chickens, goats, sheep, rabbits, a garden, orchard, and a stain-glass and spinning workshop. We welcome: girl children and dogs (maybe leashed). Visits limited to 2-3 days, $2 per person or work exchange, no drugs, alcohol or cigarettes please. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 18 acres, 2 housing/permanent structures, electricity, camping space, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: 'family of 6 lesbians, 4 on the land' so Intentional Community/Cooperative. Land: rural route copied. Residents: '4 on the land'. Accepted: girl children named. Focuses: 'provide most of our food' (farming); 'stain-glass and spinning workshop' (archives/cultural work; the workshop is crafts production, not teaching); 'no drugs, alcohol or cigarettes' (recovery/substance-free). Workshops/education is a weak call given that 'workshop' here means a craft studio.

entries.description: Couple in their 40's, vegetarian non-smokers, on 13 forested acres near the Yuba River; looking for 1-3 semi-collective members. Other parcels nearby for sale to lesbian buyers. Welcomes new members, girl and boy children, non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: CEDAR c/o Linda or Sara, PO Box 274, Camptonville, CA 95922. We are a couple in our 40's, vegies/non-smokers, living on 13 acres, deeply forested, sub-alpine beauty at 3200'. Looking for 1-3 semi-collective members, very hard to make a living locally, rural, quite isolated, wet winters, hot summers, near incredible Yuba River, other parcels for sale nearby and looking for lesbian buyers. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 13 acres, trailer, shed, electricity/well, camping space, woods, organic garden/ orchard, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: two women living on land and actively recruiting ('Looking for 1-3 semi-collective members'), so Intentional Community/Cooperative per the two-woman rule exception. Land: PO box, so street and zip blank; land_state CA from the mailing state since the listing places land nearby (Yuba River). Residents: 2 lesbians with 'women living and working on the land'. Accepted: girl and boy children and nonlesbian women named; lesbians as residents. Organic garden only in the We have list, not coded.
